column1: # lib_logtalk_routed.tsv -- THE ROUTED-CASE DECLARATION TABLE for util_logtalk_family_done.sh.
# ⛔⭐ SCOPED MEANS ROUTED, NEVER SUBTRACTED (cto ruling to hq_C, 2026-09-13). A family row's DONE-WHEN may
# narrow to the cases in its owner's lane -- a DONE-WHEN that can only be met by work in ANOTHER seat's lane
# either stalls forever or makes its owner cross the lane line -- but narrowing a denominator is the single
# easiest way to manufacture a false green: 138 becomes 127, the row closes, and eleven real defects leave
# the accounting without anyone deciding they should. A case that is dropped silently and a case that was
# never measured produce THE SAME OUTPUT. So a narrowed denominator NAMES EVERY CASE IT DROPS AND THE ROW
# THAT NOW OWNS IT, here, in a file the gate reads on every run and prints by name in its verdict.
# ⛔⭐ AND THE DECLARATION EXPIRES BY ITSELF, which is the whole reason it is a table and not a prose list in
# a baton. A tolerated-red list is written when the red is discovered and read long after it is closed, so it
# goes stale in the FLATTERING direction -- it invites a reader to tolerate a failure that is now a real
# regression (CLAUDE.md, THE CONTROL-ARM BAR: two successive digests each named the red that had just been
# cured). This gate therefore REFUSES(2) rather than passing when a routed case PASSES -- the owning row has
# landed and the case must come back into this row's denominator -- and REFUSES(2) when a routed case is not
# in the group's population at all, because a name that matches nothing is a carve-out no one can audit.
# group<TAB>case<TAB>owner-row<TAB>why it is not this row's to cure
